blocks.text: INDIAN WELLS, California— Coco Gauff came agonizingly close to extending her stellar season at the WTA Finals. If not for the vagaries of the event’s convoluted round-robin play, one of the game’s brightest stars would be still be around for the final weekend of the $10 million event. READ: Jessica Pegula advances to WTA Finals semifinals; Coco Gauff out In her fifth consecutive Finals appearance, Gauff won two of her three matches, as did Linda Noskova and Jessica Pegula.
